slides.title: 5 switches on the Claude Code panel most people never flip.
slides.sub: Every one of them is a one-line setup once you know where it lives.
slides.voiceover: Claude Code has five settings almost nobody flips on.

slides.label: THE PANEL
slides.title: Five switches, what each one does
items: CLAUDE.md
Instructions Claude reads automatically at the start of every session
Slash commands
Your own reusable `/commands`, saved as a file
Permission modes
How much Claude does before it stops and asks
Hooks
Shell commands that fire on Claude Code's own events
Subagents
Helpers with their own tools and their own context window
slides.voiceover: CLAUDE.md, slash commands, permission modes, hooks, and subagents.

slides.label: SWITCH 1 · MEMORY
slides.title: CLAUDE.md: it never forgets your project
steps: A markdown file in your project's root folder
Run `/init` — Claude scans the codebase and drafts one
Reads automatically at the start of every session
slides.voiceover: CLAUDE.md is a file Claude reads at the start of every session.

slides.label: SWITCH 2 · SHORTCUTS
slides.name: Custom slash commands
slides.prompt: Save a markdown file at `.claude/commands/deploy.md` with your steps written out, and Claude turns the filename into `/deploy` — one word instead of retyping the whole routine.
slides.note: Add `$ARGUMENTS` inside the file to pass in details, like `/deploy staging`.
slides.voiceover: A markdown file in dot claude commands becomes your own slash command.

slides.label: SWITCH 3 · CONTROL
slides.title: Permission modes: how much it asks first
items: default
Asks before every file edit and most shell commands
plan
Only reads and proposes a plan, changes nothing yet
acceptEdits
Auto-accepts file edits, still asks before risky commands
bypassPermissions
Skips prompts entirely — for sandboxes, not daily use
slides.voiceover: Permission modes set how much Claude does before it stops and asks you.

slides.label: SWITCH 4 · AUTOMATION
slides.title: Hooks: your own code on Claude's events
steps: A shell command that runs automatically on a Claude Code event
Run your test suite automatically after every file edit
Type `/hooks` inside Claude Code to see every hook that's live
slides.voiceover: Hooks run your own shell commands automatically on Claude Code's own events.

slides.label: SWITCH 5 · DELEGATION
slides.title: Subagents: a helper with its own window
items: Where they live
One markdown file per subagent, inside `.claude/agents/`
What's inside
A name, a description, and which tools it's allowed to use
Why it helps
Big searches and logs stay out of your main conversation
How to call one
Claude picks one automatically, or you name it directly
slides.voiceover: Subagents are separate helpers, each with its own tools and its own context.

slides.title: Five switches.
slides.title2: None of them cost more than a minute.
lines: `/init` in your next Claude Code session
slides.voiceover: Five switches, one minute each — start with slash init in your next session.
